result.summary: Found 3 major layout issues where content is visually cut off or overflowing the screen boundaries, preventing users from seeing complete restaurant cards and information.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is horizontally cut off on the right edge, making the full restaurant name and potentially other details invisible
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel or grid layout to ensure all cards fit within the viewport or implement proper horizontal scrolling with clear affordances (scroll indicators)

issues.description: The second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' section is vertically cut off at the bottom of the page, showing only a partial view with incomplete content
issues.suggestion: Adjust spacing, padding, or container height to ensure cards are fully visible, or add adequate bottom margin/padding to show complete content before the bottom navigation bar

issues.description: The category filter buttons appear to have additional categories cut off on the right side (visible scroll overflow)
issues.suggestion: Implement a horizontal scrolling indicator or carousel functionality to clearly show that more categories are available, or adjust button sizes to fit all categories in viewport
